newsitem.title: UK: ATHLETICS-LIVINGSTON HEADING FOR INTERNATIONAL RETURN.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-LIVINGSTON HEADING FOR INTERNATIONAL RETURN.

text.p: Sprinter Jason Livingston, who was banned for four years for a doping offence, lined himself up for an international return when he won the 60 metres title at Britain's AAA indoor championships on Saturday.

Livingston, sent home from the 1992 Barcelona Olympics after random tests showed he had been using steroids, won the 60 in 6.58 seconds -- the second-fastest time in the world this year -- to put himself in line for a place in the British team at the world indoor championships in Paris in March.
